archetypes.name: root-contract
archetypes.rationale: Consumer/plugin dual-root validation is the regression surface.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review every changed validator caller for the intended root contract. Confirm --repo-root uses the consumer repo when available and CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT remains the plugin cache. Pay special attention to fallback behavior outside a git worktree. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: publish-tail
archetypes.rationale: Step 5c publish result rows feed wrapper control flow.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review Step 5c publish and lifecycle result-env handling. Confirm new VALIDATE_MISSING_SCRIPT_COUNT behavior is additive, does not disturb existing rc 4 semantics, and remains visible to the prompt-side validator-defect branch. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
